text: Civil Engineering is a discipline centered on the construction of various types of infrastructure and architectural projects, covering the entire process including planning, design, construction, operation and maintenance. Its research objects include building construction, Bridges, roads, tunnels, water conservancy projects, underground projects, etc., aiming to solve the spatial needs for human survival and development through engineering technology. This major integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as mathematics, mechanics, materials science, and computer technology, aiming to cultivate compound talents with engineering practice ability and innovative thinking, and to meet the national strategic demands such as urbanization, transportation construction, and disaster prevention and mitigation.
